based_on.commit_semantics: HEAD at run time; this artifact is committed in the next commit, so code_commit is that commit's parent
based_on.note: 只读冻结 evidence.json（canonical LF 字节 hash 绑定，失配即拒）；未读取 model_race.json / 任何 P90 字段

rule.D1: demand.remaining_3m.forecast_p50 (P50 point forecast, live SO excluded)
rule.D2: demand.remaining_3m.p50 (= D1 + positive live open SO; SO<->forecast overlap unproven, may double count)
rule.supply_A: A_low = available; A_high = available + open production remaining (no PO, no intransit)
rule.supply_B: B_min = available + max(raw PO, production remaining, intransit) (maximum overlap); B_max = available + raw PO + production remaining + intransit (no overlap)

tests.t2: inventory.uom_status is a verified unit basis (false for 10/10: unknown_conditional)
tests.t3: B_max < D1 (short even at the most generous supply bound, on the P50 forecast)
tests.t4: A_low < D2 <= B_max (conclusion flips between on-hand-only and all-arrivals)

assignment: always_replenish <= t3 and t1 and t2 and every required gate is ok
supply lower bound (B_min, B_min_po_dedup) below demand NEVER promotes a row: it only shows a shortage scenario exists

gates.note: R4: 短缺与充足都必须过同一组 8 个 definitive gates，并各自通过双边界检验。G7（无未上账替代供给）保证记录之和仍是上界；G8（需求上下界）保证需求侧有真实界而不是把 P50 当界。G4 只表示逐笔关系已核实，不代表记录互不重叠。

bounds.rule: 充足：已证供给下界 ≥ 需求上界；短缺：供给上界 < 需求下界；其余保持待核实
bounds.supply_lower: 在手 available，且仅在 G1/G2 ok 时才算已证（天然在窗口内、无单据重复问题）
bounds.supply_upper: available + 未结 PO 原始量 + 在产剩余 + 在途（每条只计一次；重复只会高估，方向上可作上界；需 G2/G4/G7 才可当作可用上界）
bounds.demand_lower: D1 = P50，不含 live SO；点估计不是已证下界（需 G8）
bounds.demand_upper: D2 = P50 + 正向 live SO；SO 若重复只会高估，方向上可作上界，但 P50 若低估则不再是上界（需 G8）
bounds.forbidden: B_max ≥ D2 永远不能证明充足：B_max 是记录之和，不是已证下界

rule.cover_treatment: cover is not counted in supply (V0). It is an unbooked upside supply scenario: once alias mapping and substitutability are confirmed it may REMOVE a shortage and the row must be recomputed; it can never create a shortage. It is NOT evidence that a shortage cannot occur while unmapped.

window_basis.note: 本清单的 L60/L90/L120 是**提前期窗口本身**（60/90/120 天）；V1（model_race）的动作窗口是 lead+30（90/120/150 天）。两套窗口天数不同，分类与数字不可互换。

priority_tier.2: t4 and (dedup-stress B_min - D2 < 10% of D2 or duplicate PO share >= 25% of B_max)
priority_tier.4: no arrival lever; short only when live SO is added (D2)
priority_tier.note: tier orders evidence urgency, not purchase urgency

screening.note: screening 只是信号；确定结论数见 definitive_*

totals.note: totals are cross-checks of the frozen evidence, not an aggregate demand or supply plan

SO overlapping the forecast never means SO can be deleted: bucket-level consumption first
arrival/ completion dates alone never establish sufficiency
supply lower bound below demand never promotes to always_replenish
live SO in the demand view never becomes net demand before bucket-level consumption
Cover or any unbooked supply never counts until mapping and substitutability are proven
